author: Operator
scope: Original high-overhead industrial cosmetic frame overlays on existing native doors or native door runs. Source masters only; no cloned door Def or painted aperture.

orientation.north: Rear service rim near lower image edge; front trim at upper edge.
orientation.east: Front cream rim along left edge, rear dark service rim along right edge. Long footprint dimension vertical.
orientation.south: Front cream rim near lower image edge; rear steel rim at upper edge.
orientation.west: RimWorld may mirror authored east view.

conversion_notes: Transparent aperture and outside: center alpha confirmed zero on all twelve files.
Generated RGB underneath alpha=0 may contain haze; zero RGB in alpha=0 pixels before filtering/downscale; preserve real alpha.
Sources have transparent margins and possible low-alpha edge speckles; deterministic converter should find opaque hardware crop before fitting target footprint.
These sprites are trim/frame overlays only. Native existing door aperture, door leaf, permissions and pawns remain visible and authoritative.
No gameplay, compatibility or runtime visual result is claimed.
